newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5616/5626 FXSU.
newsitem.headline: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5616/5626 FXSU.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank said it had set 5616/5626 roubles per dollar as its bid and offer rates for its operations on the currency market on Monday.
The official rate for Tuesday will be 5621.
On Friday the bid/offer rates were 5613/5623, with the official dollar rate 5618 from Saturday.
The Central Bank announces daily bid/offer dollar/rouble rates for its currency operations. The midpoint of these rates is the official dollar/rouble rate for the following day.
